name: Extus
description: Extus is the masked leader of the Oriq, who attacks Strixhaven and binds himself to the Snarl to summon the Blood Avatar.

description_citations.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

summary.text: Extus is the masked leader of the Oriq, who attacks Strixhaven and binds himself to the Snarl to summon the Blood Avatar.

citations.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

bio.text: Extus commands the Oriq, reserves special hatred for the Dragonsguard, and fails a fourth time to brew a potion in his cave.

citations.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

bio.text: He decides that the Snarl beneath the school could give him the power he needs.

citations.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

bio.text: With Lukka working with him, Extus orders the Oriq to attack as Lukka controls the mage hunters.

citations.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.
"Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

bio.text: He swings Tavver into a student's dark spell, killing him, then blasts open the Hall of Oracles doors, begins to read the ritual, and binds himself to the Snarl.

citations.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.
"Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.
"Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

bio.text: He teleports Liliana away from the Snarl and calls on the Blood Avatar to unleash its wrath.

citations.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.
"Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

bio.text: Will casts a control spell on the Blood Avatar, and the controlled avatar crushes Extus.

citations.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.
"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

bio.text: Later, in a story dated after that battle, Extus offers to share what the Oriq know about the Conjecture with Zimone, who refuses and fights him, and he departs saying they will meet again.

citations.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.
"Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.
"Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

status.text: Extus's last appearance has him depart after fighting Zimone and Dean Kianne, saying they will meet again, though a separate account has the Blood Avatar crushing him.

citations.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.
"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Tavver, an Oriq agent, hides in a tunnel beneath the Biblioplex after failing his mission.
timeline.quote: Tavver didn't know how long he had waited in that cramped tunnel beneath the Biblioplex

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Tavver recalls the professor with violet eyes who meant to kill him in a fight over a book Extus wanted.
timeline.quote: Tavver had seen true darkness in that professor's violet eyes.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus fails a fourth time to brew a potion in his cave.
timeline.quote: That was the fourth failure.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus broods over Oriq agents drained of life for the ritual, which still was not enough.
timeline.quote: every last bit of life drained from their bodies, and it wasn't enough

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus decides the Snarl beneath the school could give him the power he needs.
timeline.quote: that overlapping tangle of power hidden away below the school would offer more than enough

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus learns of a beast-calling stranger and says to let him come.
timeline.quote: Let him come.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina warns Lukka that Extus fights only for himself.
timeline.quote: Do you think Extus is going to change all that?

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus orders the Oriq to attack as Lukka controls the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Commence the attack.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx explains Extus leads the Oriq and is responsible for the attack.
timeline.quote: The man responsible for all of this. The leader of the Oriq.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus receives a book found in the East Wing from Tavver.
timeline.quote: I found it in the East Wing, just as you said, sir.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus swings Tavver into a Silverquill student's dark spell and then kills the student.
timeline.quote: Extus tightened his grip on Tavver's arm and pulled him close, spinning him into the spell's path.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus blasts open the Hall of Oracles doors.
timeline.quote: he blasted the doors off their hinges and stepped inside

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus sees the Snarl hanging over ancient containment circles.
timeline.quote: The Strixhaven Snarl hung in the air, tendrils of energy whipping and snapping around the hall.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Oriq agents arrange books and scrolls, and Extus begins to read the ritual.
timeline.quote: Extus began to read.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana senses that Extus has bound himself to the Snarl.
timeline.quote: He's already bound himself to the Snarl.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus hits Liliana with a forced translocation spell that sends her to the forest outside campus.
timeline.quote: Forced translocation magic.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus freezes and shatters Rowan's lightning and breaks Will's ice shield.
timeline.quote: shattering on the ground as if made of glass

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Blood pools across the floor and the Snarl turns from blue to deep red.
timeline.quote: Where it had glowed blue before, now it shone a deep red.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus calls upon the Blood Avatar to unleash its wrath.
timeline.quote: Rise, Great One! I call upon you, Blood Avatar!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan realizes the avatar was Extus's plan all along.
timeline.quote: This was Extus's plan all along.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus gloats before the oracle statues as the Blood Avatar rises.
timeline.quote: He whirled, gesturing wildly at the statues surrounding him.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will's ice shards at Extus are blown apart by Rowan's lightning.
timeline.quote: a bolt of lightning cracked through the shards, detonating them

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus sees the Blood Avatar faltering as the Snarl's energy flows into Rowan.
timeline.quote: The creature was moving in jerks and fits, the red light of the Snarl flickering wildly behind it.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts Extus with fire that hurls him against the wall.
timeline.quote: the spell crashed into him, sending him flying through the air, robes coiling with smoke

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus dismisses Rowan's ambition and returns to his ritual.
timeline.quote: But I've come too far to be stopped by the likes of you.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will casts a red halo control spell on the Blood Avatar's head.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a red halo of light snapped into place around the Blood Avatar's helmed head.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The controlled Blood Avatar crushes Extus.
timeline.quote: one of the massive hands of the Blood Avatar closed around him with an awful crunching sound

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone wakes to find Extus and Pita, who introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: My name is Extus

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus says they have followed Zimone for years and know about the packages.
timeline.quote: We have followed you for years.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus offers to share what the Oriq knows about the Conjecture to control the universe.
timeline.quote: And we'll tell you what we know, and together, we can control the universe.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone refuses and lashes Extus and Pita into a wall with the ribbon braid.
timeline.quote: whips the braid of blue-green ribbons at the two men, sending them crashing into the wall at the far end of the room

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Kianne bursts in with Amaka and Nnanyielugo.
timeline.quote: Get away from her!

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kianne redirects Extus's fireball, and Zimone stops and douses it with her braid.
timeline.quote: Zimone swirls the braid of blue-green ribbons, weaving it into the tiny cracks of time and space

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus departs, saying they will meet again.
timeline.quote: Though I trust we'll meet again, Zimone Wola.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

relations.note: Lukka works with the Oriq leader.
relations.quote: I'm not like your other mages.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

relations.note: He teleports her away from the Snarl.
relations.quote: He's already bound himself to the Snarl.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

relations.quote: one of the massive hands of the Blood Avatar closed around him with an awful crunching sound

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

relations.note: She refuses him and fights him.
relations.quote: whips the braid of blue-green ribbons at the two men, sending them crashing into the wall at the far end of the room

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

pages_say.description: A masked leader of the Oriq who brews failing potions and hates the Dragonsguard, and who wants the Snarl.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

pages_say.description: The leader of the Oriq who orders the attack on the school with mage hunters under Lukka's control.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

pages_say.description: The masked leader of the Oriq who sacrifices his own agent, binds himself to the Snarl, and summons the Blood Avatar.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

pages_say.description: The Oriq leader who summons the Blood Avatar and is crushed by it.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

pages_say.description: The Oriq leader who has followed Zimone for years and offers to share the Vorzani Conjecture with her.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.
